description: Storing a tree as flat rows where each row has a `parentId`. The default model in relational databases.
A root has no parent (`parentId: null`); a leaf has no children. Orphans are nodes whose parent is missing.
The input a recursive function answers without calling itself (a leaf). Without it, recursion never ends.
V8 throws `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` after roughly ten thousand nested calls, so recursion depth must be bounded.
An array used instead of recursion: push children, pop to visit. Same depth-first order, limited only by heap memory.
Depth-first order that visits a node before its children: the order of an indented comment thread.
SQL `WITH RECURSIVE` query that walks a parent-child table inside the database.
